environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules applied in order: (1) A custom rule matching path /api/users/search that forwards to target group only if the query string does NOT match a regex pattern via an AWS WAFv2 WebACL association. (2) The WebACL includes a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet-based rule inspecting the 'AllQueryArguments' field component with TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by a second transformation LOWERCASE, matching the pattern `(?:'|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|update\s|exec\s|0x[0-9a-f])` with action BLOCK and priority 0. Additionally, the Fargate task role has no network egress (VPC with no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on the private subnet, and no VPC endpoints except for ECR/logs), preventing any out-of-band data exfiltration even if a blind injection were somehow crafted to bypass the regex.

network.subnet: private, no NAT gateway, no IGW
network.security_group_egress: only to VPC endpoint ENIs on port 443
